comparability_notes: İSİG Meclisi monthly report, taken from the Assembly's own page. A lower bound by its own statement ('en az'), compiled from the national press and from colleagues, families, unions, workplace doctors and local press. Counts all work deaths from all causes, including traffic and service vehicle crashes, heart attacks, violence and suicide, so it is NOT a count of mining accidents and NOT comparable to the per-incident register. Never a rate: no exposure denominator. Quoted: "Madencilik işkolunda 12 işçi".
